changelog:
Instagram Reel download automation for WhatsApp.

- New skill to download Instagram Reels via sssinstagram.com and return as a WhatsApp-ready video.
- Adds scripts for automated download (`download_via_sss.mjs`) and optional cleanup (`cleanup_reels.sh`).
- Validates link format and uses Playwright automation with a Chromium-compatible browser.
- Removed caption-writing script; no longer provides content, now focused on media file delivery.
- Handles download storage via configurable environment variables, with user privacy precautions.
